clauses.heading: What we do
clauses.text: Agency will run Client's social media, seasonal campaigns and in-store promo materials, as agreed month to month by email.

clauses.heading: Money
clauses.text: Retainer is AZN 12,000 a month, invoiced on the 1st. Client pays net seven (7) days. If Client is late, Agency may pause all work and charge a flat late fee of AZN 1,500 for each week of delay.

clauses.heading: Creative work
clauses.text: Campaign concepts, designs and copy are jointly owned by Agency and Client. Agency may reuse any concept for its other clients after six (6) months.

clauses.heading: If things go wrong
clauses.text: Agency is not responsible for any loss whatsoever, however caused, including where a campaign breaches advertising rules.

clauses.heading: How long
clauses.text: This retainer runs for two years from 15 March 2025 and then rolls over for another twenty-four (24) months each time, unless one side tells the other in writing ninety (90) days before the end.

clauses.heading: Getting out early
clauses.text: Client can end the retainer early only by paying the remaining monthly retainers for the rest of the term.

clauses.heading: Freelancers
clauses.text: Agency uses freelancers and partner studios as it sees fit.

clauses.heading: Law
clauses.text: Azerbaijani law applies and the Baku courts decide any dispute.
